title: Adaptive Learning Path Designer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Challenger Selling
description: Learners read three student performance scenarios and route each student to a remedial, standard, or advanced learning path, with feedback on which signals drove the decision.

learningObjectives: Design adaptive learning paths by selecting content recommendations based on student performance scenarios.

keyQuestions: Design adaptive learning paths by selecting content recommendations based on student performance scenarios.
commonMisconceptions: All students should follow the same path.
Adaptive learning is only for struggling students.
assessmentOpportunities: Correct path for all three students.
Learner can name at least two signals beyond quiz score.
